type Numeric = { [n: number]: string } | { other: number };
function notNumericName(x: Numeric): void {
  if ("1e3" in x) console.log(x[0].toUpperCase());
}
function leadingZero(x: Numeric): void {
  if ("01" in x) console.log(x[0].toUpperCase());
}
function falseKeepsIndex(x: Numeric): void {
  if (0 in x) console.log(x);
  else console.log(x.other);
}
function negatedKeepsIndex(x: Numeric): void {
  if (!(0 in x)) {
    const other: { other: number } = x;
    console.log(other);
  }
}
function falseKeepsOptional(x: { a?: number } | { b: string }): void {
  if ("a" in x) console.log(x);
  else {
    const b: { b: string } = x;
    console.log(b);
  }
}
function falseKeepsStringIndex(x: { [k: string]: number } | { other: string }): void {
  if ("q" in x) console.log(x);
  else console.log(x.other);
}
function unknownKeyFalse(x: { a: number } | { b: string }): void {
  if (!("c" in x)) console.log(x.c);
}
notNumericName({ other: 1 });
leadingZero({ other: 1 });
falseKeepsIndex({ other: 1 });
negatedKeepsIndex({ other: 1 });
falseKeepsOptional({ b: "x" });
falseKeepsStringIndex({ other: "y" });
unknownKeyFalse({ a: 1 });
